images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a premium editorial FITNESS PHOTOGRAPH, landscape 3:2 at high resolution, for a calm iPhone fitness challenge card. Natural credible bodies and candid effort; lifelike textures, editorial camera realism. This must be a full bleed photograph, no typography, no layout, no watermarks, NO logos or brand marks on clothing, shoes or equipment. Subject must read clearly in an extremely wide 3.2:1 crop across the MIDDLE of the frame, with the athlete at center-right, fully inside the central horizontal band, and calm dark lower-left negative space for white UI text. Natural colour, clear details and visible light, no heavy haze, no tinted filters. Anonymous adult recreational athletes, no celebrities, no event branding. Spring fitness challenge: an athletic adult woman and man jogging comfortably along a park path with fresh green leaves and subtle blossom. Medium-wide side view; runners at center-right in the middle band, warm soft morning light; calm natural colour and a realistic green park. No racing bibs.
